crossToolNote.zh: 无遥测越权（.claude/.codex 仅用于用户主动导入会话与技能发现）
crossToolNote.en: None for telemetry (.claude/.codex used only for explicit session import & skill discovery)

hardwareFingerprint.zh: 使用 node-machine-id 硬件指纹作为 distinctId
hardwareFingerprint.en: Uses node-machine-id hardware fingerprint as distinctId

oneLiner.zh: 默认开 PostHog + 硬件指纹 node-machine-id，但文档坦白披露且支持 DO_NOT_TRACK=1；注意关闭遥测后仍会带硬件指纹调 data.cline.bot/decide 拉 Feature Flags。
oneLiner.en: Default-on PostHog with node-machine-id, transparently documented and honoring DO_NOT_TRACK=1; still contacts data.cline.bot/decide with distinctId for feature flags when telemetry is off.

title.zh: 关闭遥测后仍带硬件指纹请求 /decide 拉取 Feature Flags
title.en: Feature flag /decide requests still send machine distinctId when telemetry is off

summary.zh: apps/vscode-rollout/src/rollout.ts 使用 node-machine-id 向 data.cline.bot/decide?v=3 拉取灰度开关，不受遥测关闭控制（文档 L62 已如实说明）。
summary.en: `rollout.ts` POSTs `{ api_key, distinct_id }` derived from `node-machine-id` to `data.cline.bot/decide?v=3` even when telemetry is disabled (disclosed in telemetry.mdx:L62).

mitigationNote.zh: 设置 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 或在 Cline 设置中关闭“Allow error and usage reporting”。
mitigationNote.en: Export DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or CLINE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1, or toggle off in Cline Settings → General.
